description: (needs account token) Turns off email for a site's domain. It stops renewing and keeps working until the end of the month already paid. Turning it back on is not done here. confirm=true applies it. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: turn_off_email
title: Turn off email
